title: Grayscale Files for Bittensor Spot ETF Under GTAO
summary: Grayscale Investments filed with the SEC to transition its over-the-counter Bittensor Trust into a spot ETF on NYSE Arca, positioning the firm to offer regulated exposure to TAO as institutional altcoin ETF competition intensifies following new generic listing standards.
